struct FlowEdge {
    int v, u;
    ll cap, flow;
    FlowEdge(int v, int u, ll cap) : v(v), u(u), cap(cap), flow(0) {}
};

struct Dinic {
    const ll flow_inf = 1e18;
    vector<FlowEdge> edges;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    int n;
    int s, t;
    vector<int> level, ptr;
    queue<int> q;

    Dinic(int n, int s, int t) : n(n), s(s), t(t) {
        adj.resize(n);
        level.resize(n);
        ptr.resize(n);
    }

    void add_edge(int v, int u, ll cap) {
        edges.emplace_back(v, u, cap);
        edges.emplace_back(u, v, 0);
        adj[v].push_back(edges.size() - 2);
        adj[u].push_back(edges.size() - 1);
    }

    bool bfs() {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        level[s] = 0;
        q.push(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int id : adj[v]) {
                auto& e = edges[id];
                if (e.cap - e.flow <= 0 || level[e.u] != -1) continue;
                level[e.u] = level[v] + 1;
                q.push(e.u);
            }
        }
        return level[t] != -1;
    }

    ll dfs(int v, ll pushed) {
        if (pushed == 0) return 0;
        if (v == t) return pushed;
        for (int& cid = ptr[v]; cid < (int)adj[v].size(); cid++) {
            int id = adj[v][cid];
            auto& e = edges[id];
            if (level[e.u] != level[v] + 1 || e.cap - e.flow <= 0) continue;
            ll tr = dfs(e.u, min(pushed, e.cap - e.flow));
            if (tr == 0) continue;
            e.flow += tr;
            edges[id ^ 1].flow -= tr;
            return tr;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    ll flow() {
        ll max_flow = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            fill(ptr.begin(), ptr.end(), 0);
            while (ll pushed = dfs(s, flow_inf)) {
                max_flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return max_flow;
    }
};

struct Edge {
    int src, dst;
    ll capacity, current_flow;
    Edge(int s, int d, ll c) : src(s), dst(d), capacity(c), current_flow(0) {}
};

class MaxFlowAlgorithm {
public:
    const ll INF = 1e18;
    vector<Edge> edgelist;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    int V, source, sink;
    vector<int> depth, it;
    queue<int> q;

    MaxFlowAlgorithm(int nodes, int s, int t)
        : V(nodes), source(s), sink(t) {
        adj.resize(V);
        depth.resize(V);
        it.resize(V);
    }

    void insert(int u, int v, ll cap) {
        edgelist.emplace_back(u, v, cap);
        edgelist.emplace_back(v, u, 0);
        adj[u].push_back(edgelist.size() - 2);
        adj[v].push_back(edgelist.size() - 1);
    }

    bool build_levels() {
        fill(depth.begin(), depth.end(), -1);
        depth[source] = 0;
        q.push(source);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int idx : adj[u]) {
                auto& e = edgelist[idx];
                if (e.capacity - e.current_flow > 0 && depth[e.dst] == -1) {
                    depth[e.dst] = depth[u] + 1;
                    q.push(e.dst);
                }
            }
        }
        return depth[sink] != -1;
    }

    ll augment(int u, ll bottleneck) {
        if (u == sink) return bottleneck;
        for (int& i = it[u]; i < (int)adj[u].size(); ++i) {
            int idx = adj[u][i];
            auto& e = edgelist[idx];
            if (depth[e.dst] == depth[u] + 1 && e.capacity - e.current_flow > 0) {
                ll flow = augment(e.dst, min(bottleneck, e.capacity - e.current_flow));
                if (flow > 0) {
                    e.current_flow += flow;
                    edgelist[idx ^ 1].current_flow -= flow;
                    return flow;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    ll max_flow() {
        ll total = 0;
        while (build_levels()) {
            fill(it.begin(), it.end(), 0);
            while (ll flow = augment(source, INF)) {
                total += flow;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }
};
